bulletins.title: Pre-flight Information Bulletin for NETHERLANDS, 2026-09-22 at 16:07 UTC (18:07 CEST)

relevant.reason: Destination runway declared distances changed; affects landing performance at EHHV.
relevant.summary: At Hilversum, runway 18/36 declared distances are now 620 m for TORA, TODA, ASDA, and LDA. Check your aircraft's performance for this shorter runway.
relevant.raw:
B0960/26
Q) EHAA/QMDCH/IV/NBO/A/000/999/5212N00509E005
A) EHHV  B) FROM: 26/08/24 10:00  TO: 26/11/24 12:00 EST
E) RWY 18/36 DECLARED DISTANCES CHANGED TO:
TORA/TODA/ASDA/LDA 620M.

relevant.reason: Destination requires PPR and pilots must report to tower in person before departure.
relevant.summary: Hilversum requires prior permission (PPR) and pilots of departing aircraft must report to the tower in person before flight. Arrange PPR and plan to visit the tower if departing from EHHV.
relevant.raw:
B0993/26
Q) EHAA/QFAAP/IV/NBO/A/000/999/5212N00509E005
A) EHHV  B) FROM: 26/08/31 00:00  TO: 26/10/14 15:00 EST
E) AD PPR. PILOTS OF DEP ACFT REPORT TO TWR IN PERSON BEFORE FLT.

relevant.reason: CTR exit via Bravo departure only; Mike departure not available, affects VFR departure from EHLE.
relevant.summary: When leaving the control zone at Lelystad, you must use the Bravo departure; the Mike departure is not available (except for communication failure). Plan your departure route accordingly.
relevant.raw:
A2067/26
Q) EHAA/QPECH/V/NBO/A/000/999/5227N00531E005
A) EHLE  B) FROM: 26/09/03 09:36  TO: 26/12/03 09:00 EST
E) EXIT CTR VIA BRAVO DEP. MIKE DEP NOT AVBL, EXCEPT FOR COM-FAILURE
PROCEDURES.
REF AIP EHLE AD 2.22 PARA 4.2 AND 4.3 AND AD 2.EHLE-VAC.1.

relevant.reason: CTR entry via Mike arrival only; Bravo arrival not available, affects VFR arrival at EHLE.
relevant.summary: When entering the control zone at Lelystad, you must use the Mike arrival; the Bravo arrival is not available (except for special VFR). Plan your arrival route accordingly.
relevant.raw:
A2068/26
Q) EHAA/QPBCH/V/NBO/A/000/999/5227N00531E005
A) EHLE  B) FROM: 26/09/03 09:37  TO: 26/12/03 09:00 EST
E) ENTER CTR VIA MIKE ARR.
BRAVO ARR NOT AVBL (SPECIAL VFR EXEMPTED) .
REF AIP EHLE AD 2.22 PARA 4.2 AND 4.3 AND AD 2.EHLE-VAC.1.

relevant.reason: Obstacle lights unserviceable at a wind farm 8.6 nm from departure, within the flight window and altitude band.
relevant.summary: Obstacle lights are out on the wind turbines at Windpark IJsselmeer and Windpark Blauw (621 ft AMSL), about 8.6 nm from Lelystad. Be extra vigilant for unlit turbines, especially in reduced visibility or at night.

AMSL. REF AIP ENR 5.4 (ID 617).

relevant.reason: Mobile crane near departure runway, marked and lit, within flight window and altitude band.
relevant.summary: A mobile crane is located near runway 05 at Lelystad, between 553 m and 655 m beyond the threshold and 235 m right of the centerline, height 160 ft AMSL. It is marked and lit, but be aware of the obstacle on departure from runway 05.

relevant.reason: Migrating geese at departure aerodrome, active during daylight hours which includes the flight window.
